newsitem.title: USA: Killer fugitive is arrested in southern California.
newsitem.headline: Killer fugitive is arrested in southern California.

text.p: A murderer who escaped from a California prison last month was arrested in San Diego early Saturday after allegedly robbing a restaurant, police said.

San Diego police found David Anderson in an alley near a restaurant which had just been robbed. Anderson, who allegedly used a shotgun to hold up the restaurant, was taken into custody without incident, police Sgt. Fred Wilson said. No-one was injured in the robbery.

Anderson, 36, escaped from a ward for HIV-positive inmates at the medium-security California Medical Facility in Vacaville, 50 miles northeast of San Francisco, on April 10. He left a crude dummy in his bed to fool guards, cut through window bars and lowered himself three floors to the ground with bed sheets.
The next day, he kidnapped a newspaper deliveryman, forced him to drive him to San Francisco and then stole his truck. He later sent a taunting letter to prison officials.
When he escaped, Anderson was in the last year of a 16-year sentence for second-degree murder, grand theft, receiving stolen property and robbery in San Diego County.
Wilson said Anderson would be tried in San Diego on a robbery charge before being returned to Vacaville. State officials said he would face additional charges for escaping from prison.
